title: 第二十五章 玄冰蠕虫和地心火灵芝第二十六章 幻影镜
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
虽然心痒，但事情总要一桩桩来。
和楚飞鹤的天道羁绊，显然还太浅了，这个家伙，暂时只能放过，赢商继续朝着自己的方向里飞去。
……
咔嚓！
咔嚓！
某座雪谷之中，碎裂之声爆起，冰雾滚滚爆炸开来，伴随着大片飞溅的雪虫尸体。
赢商大开杀戒，右臂金光爆闪，不断挥洒出巨大的金色刀芒来，金色刀芒又连绵成汹涌的浪潮，连绵不绝轰去。
他此刻施展的，正是浪三刀拿手的磐气期神通——百重斩，是怒火道宗最厉害的磐气境界的，金行神通之一！
轰击的同时，赢商横眉怒目，怒喝连连。
看似处在愤怒状态里，其实心头上一片冷静澄明，片刻之后，这个老狐狸，到底还是把怒容收了起来，无奈摇头。
“这门怒火霸刀天赋，到底还是更适合三刀一些。”
“他是天生的暴烈性子，一点就炸，而我则是终究太冷静了，除非被人彻底惹怒，否则怒火霸刀天赋，对我的神通的威力加成不大。”
赢商心中喃喃。
一边打着，一边还能思索。
“……若是能搞到，使人进入愤怒状态的灵丹妙药，那就最好了，或许——还有类似效果的功法，更是上佳。”
想到这里，心头火热，他虽然不知道，但未必没有，找就是！
……
又片刻之后，这处雪虫的巢穴，被赢商彻底破开。一冲而下，灵识也扫去，下方景象，顿时印入脑海之中。
下方深谷，破破烂烂，那种破烂，不是被轰的破烂的那种，而是腐蚀一般的破烂，泥土，冰层，石头，仿佛全被腐蚀过，表面还残留着乳白色粘液样的古怪东西，散发着说不上恶臭，但十分古怪的味道，更有强大的冰霜力量。

除此之外，还有大量掉落下来的雪虫的尸体，还有一头头幼虫，甚至还有一颗颗虫卵。
这里的雪虫的样子，白白胖胖，又身躯有节，仿佛蠕虫，这玩意叫做玄冰蠕虫，是生存在连天大雪山中的妖虫之一。
他们的分泌出的那些乳白色粘液，叫做冰涎香，蕴藏着强大的冰行力量，是炼制冰行法宝，甚至是炼丹的好材料。
而赢商，正是为此而来！
那些拿出大补小补金元气的灵丹妙药，灵花异草的势力，需求的其中一味材料，就是冰涎香。
赢商以前，就知道这处地方，这一次算是赚到了，而且这里还没有被其他修士清剿过。
扫了一圈，见没有什么厉害的玄冰蠕虫，赢商再不耽搁，顶着护身飞去，收起那些冰涎香来。
……
无边无际般的连天大雪山中，大片的地方，已经被先来的修士搜刮过，大地明显被轰的破破烂烂。
这种地方，肯定是不用去了，就算还有遗留的，多半也是前人打不过，赢商也不打算尝试。对他来说，在保持前往东北大方向的同时，寻找没被早到修士搜刮过的地方就行。
打的过就打。
打不过就跑。
赢商虽然是磐气初期的境界，但靠着丰富的战斗经验，高明的法术，还有厉害的法宝，傀儡等辅助之物，真实的战斗力，直抵磐气后期的层次。这个老狐狸，境界虽然跌落了，但以前搜罗的法宝等物还全在。
时间一天天过去。
转眼七八天，赢商越进越深，见到的修士却不多，连天大雪山的范围，太广阔了，进来的修士，仿佛墨汁入水一般，飞快的消失的无影无踪。

Although it is itchy, things will eventually come one after another.
The bond of heaven with Chu Feihe is obviously too shallow. He can only let this guy go for the time being, and Ying Shang continues to fly in his own direction.
…
Click!
Click!
In a certain snow valley, the sound of shattering erupted, and ice mist rolled and exploded, accompanied by large exploding bodies of snow bugs.
Ying Shang went on a killing spree, his right arm flashed with golden light, and he continued to release a huge golden sword light. The golden sword light continued into a raging wave and blasted away continuously.
What he is displaying at this moment is the Pan Qi stage magical power that Lang Sandao is good at - Hundredfold Slash, which is one of the most powerful Pan Qi realm of Wrath Dao Sect, and one of the Golden Element magical powers!
At the same time as the bombardment, Ying Shang frowned and shouted angrily.
Although he seemed to be in a state of anger, his heart was actually calm and clear. After a moment, the old fox finally put away his angry expression and shook his head helplessly.
"This talent of wrathful sword is more suitable for three swords after all."
"He is born with a violent temper and will explode at the slightest moment, but I am too calm after all. Unless I am completely angered by someone, the talent of rage and sword will not add much to the power of my magical powers."
Yingshang murmured in his heart.
While typing, I can still think.
"...If you can get a panacea that can make people enter a state of anger, that would be the best. Maybe - there are also techniques with similar effects, which would be even better."
Thinking of this, his heart was burning. Although he didn't know, it might not be there. Just look for it!
…
After a while, the snow insect's nest was completely broken open by Ying Shang. As he rushed down, his spiritual consciousness was swept away, and the scene below was immediately imprinted in his mind.
In the deep valley below, there are rags and rags. The rags are not the kind of rags that have been blasted, but corroded rags. The soil, ice, and stones seem to have been corroded, and there are still strange milky white mucus-like things remaining on the surface. It exudes a smell that cannot be said to be foul, but very strange, and has powerful frost power.
In addition, there were a large number of fallen snow insect corpses, larvae, and even insect eggs.
The snow worms here look white, fat, and have jointed bodies, like worms. They are called black ice worms, and they are one of the monster insects that live in the snow-capped mountains.
The milky white mucus they secrete is called ice saliva, which contains powerful ice power and is a good material for refining ice magic weapons and even alchemy.
And Yingshang is here for exactly this!
Those who come up with panacea, magical flowers and herbs that can greatly replenish gold and vitality, and one of the ingredients they need is ice saliva.
I knew this place before Ying Shang, so I made a profit this time, and this place has not been cleared by other monks yet.
After scanning around, he saw that there were no powerful black ice worms. Ying Shang flew away without any further delay and put away the ice worms.
…
In the boundless snow-capped mountains, large areas have been plundered by the monks who came first, and the ground was obviously in tatters.
There is definitely no need to go to a place like this. Even if there are still some leftovers, most of them cannot be beaten by previous generations, and Yingshang has no intention of trying. For him, while keeping heading in the northeast direction, he just needs to look for places that have not been raided by the monks who arrived earlier.
If you can fight, fight.
If you can't fight, run away.
Although Ying Shang is at the early stage of Pan Qi, relying on his rich combat experience, superb spells, and powerful magic weapons, puppets and other auxiliary objects, his true combat effectiveness has reached the late stage of Pan Qi. Although this old fox's realm has declined, all the magic weapons and other items he collected before are still there.
Time passes day by day.
In the blink of an eye, for seven or eight days, Yingshang went deeper and deeper, but not many monks were seen. The scope of the snow-capped mountains was too vast, and the monks who came in disappeared quickly without a trace, as if ink had entered the water.
